description: Repository config on top of the shared preset github>thomas-lg/renovate-config (schedule, dashboard, deps prefix, labels, squash, GitHub Actions groups). Translated from the former .github/dependabot.yml: same ecosystems, groups and ignores. No auto-merge: every merge to main publishes :latest.

packageRules.description: One PR for every NuGet minor and patch: a bump in Application or Infrastructure also rewrites the packages.lock.json of Api and Tests, which Renovate restores together (dotnet restore --force-evaluate on every dependent project).
Every base-image bump edits the same Dockerfile; ungrouped they conflict with each other one merge at a time (#67/#68, then #87/#88).
Pinned so a rebuild cannot silently change what every scan reads; the OCR benchmark in CI is the review.
engines and packageManager in package.json are not dependency bumps: Dependabot never touched them, Node and npm move with an Angular upgrade.

Microsoft.OpenApi 3.x makes IOpenApiMediaType.Example read-only, which the Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi source generator still assigns to (CS0200). Unblocked only by an ASP.NET Core release built against OpenApi 3.x.
Angular pins TypeScript to a narrow peer range (@angular/build 22 wants >=6.0 <6.1): majors and minors move with an Angular upgrade, patches flow.
@angular/build's unit-test builder declares peerOptional vitest@^4.0.8 through 22.1.x (#122). Drop this when 22.2 ships stable and move both together.
Node's major is pinned by Angular's supported range and must stay in step with ci.yml's node-version and the devcontainer's node feature (#92): moved deliberately, in all places at once.
.NET majors (SDK, runtime images, the runtime-bound Microsoft.* packages) are a deliberate upgrade, not a weekly bump.
The devcontainer's node feature takes a major only ("24"); pinning it to a full version would stop it tracking the LTS line it is meant to follow.
